implementation.policy: Closed observed initializer recipe, original allocation identities/flags/sizes/ranges, direct pointer/base relationships, fixed controls and explicit polling IRQ normalization
implementation.owner: Serialized one-shot controller, no new UAPI; READY and QUARANTINED retain ownership; release only before first possible write or after a separate quiescence hook proves safe; no automatic release retry after partial cleanup
implementation.deadline: 500 ms hardware-sequence deadline with independent 10000-read cap; individual platform hooks must be bounded
implementation.production_connection: Compiled into services but has no bridge ioctl, module parameter or live provider; existing parent and prepare-only MMIO gate unchanged

Failure at each of 45 controller writes with both failed and successful quiescence
Acquire/verify/reset/publish/status failure; interrupted status and one-shot retry rejection

Quiescence failure or absent hook retains owner; partial release not retried
